title: 第23章 水泥牡蛎第24章 墨家客卿
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
裴茂愣了一下，第一次见到这么不客气的年轻人。
自从他身居高位以来，哪个年轻人在自己的面前不是像孔雀开屏一样展示自己的才华和风度。
哪有人像沈无名这样？
给他机会成名，不知感谢敲诈自己就算了，居然还要先给钱。
难不成还担心他裴茂赖账不成？
“这年轻人……有点意思。”裴茂心头暗道，随即在身上摸了摸，没钱？
以他的身份，平常也不会带钱在身上，花钱的地方自有下人打理。
这会儿全身摸了一遍，一个子儿都没有。
沈无名反倒是灼灼的盯着他，眼中充满了怀疑。
裴茂读懂了，沈无名是在怀疑他赖账？
天老爷，他堂堂二品大员，墨家巨头，犯得着赖三万两金票？
“那啥……裴大人要是觉得亏的话，我就先下去了。”沈无名转头就打算离开。
裴茂咬了咬牙，解下腰间的玉佩，“给你，这玩意儿我十万两买的。”
“十万两银子吧？”沈无名不太懂玉石这些。
摸了摸，也就是挺光滑的，另外就是有点油……这狗日的，不会没洗手吧？
沈无名满脸的怀疑，不过想了想，还是决定把这玉石收下。
随即裴茂一个人走上高台，跟变脸一样，那张黑脸很快就喜笑颜开。
“永定河的麻烦的确挺难，大家一时半会儿都没有什么好办法。”
“不过，却有一位墨家天才有想法，这位公子大家也都很熟悉！”
“家世才情，以及本身对墨家之道的研究，都极为不俗。”

裴茂卖了个关子，众人却心生疑惑，到底是什么人能让裴茂夸到这种程度？
曹茱萸吗？
不过这种人想了想，刚才裴茂说的是公子，毫无疑问，是个男子才对。
那么……
众人的目光在人群中打量，最终全部都落到了孟文绰的身上。
毫无疑问。
在场的墨家弟子，抛开曹茱萸不谈的话，也就只有孟文绰能孚众望。
而且说到家世、才情、天赋和对于墨家之道的研究，也只有他满足这个条件。
就连孟文绰都是这样想的。
他刚才的确有些想法，没想到裴茂居然主动邀请他，想到这，脸上也露出一些得意。
在谢如素崇拜的目光中，孟文绰整理了一下衣裳。
面带笑容，迎着众人的的视线走向高台。
众人朝着两边散开，如同迎接王者一样，让孟文绰极为受用。
“这位公子就是……”裴茂拉长了声音，“寿亭侯府的姑爷，分牛问题的解决者，沈无名沈公子！”
content_en:
Pei Mao was stunned for a moment. It was the first time he saw such an rude young man.
Since he has been in a high position, which young man has not displayed his talent and grace in front of him like a peacock spreading its tail.
How could anyone be like Shen Wuming?
Give him a chance to become famous, and even if he doesn't know how to thank him and blackmail him, he still has to give him money first.
Is it possible that he is still worried that Pei Mao will default on his debt?
"This young man... is a bit interesting." Pei Mao thought to himself, and then touched his body, no money?
With his status, he usually doesn't carry money with him, and his servants take care of the place where he spends money.
I felt all over my body now, but there was not a penny left.
Instead, Shen Wuming stared at him fiercely, his eyes full of suspicion.
Pei Mao understood. Is Shen Wuming suspecting him of defaulting on his debt?
Lord, he is a second-grade official and a mogul of the Mohist family. Is he guilty of relying on thirty thousand taels of gold tickets?
"Then... If Mr. Pei feels that he is at a loss, I will go down first." Shen Wuming turned around and planned to leave.
Pei Mao gritted his teeth and took off the jade pendant from his waist, "Here you go, I bought this thing for 100,000 taels."
"One hundred thousand taels of silver, right?" Shen Wuming didn't know much about jade.
I touched it and found that it was quite smooth, and a little oily... Did this bitch not wash his hands?
Shen Wuming's face was full of doubts, but after thinking about it, he decided to accept the jade.
Then Pei Mao walked up to the high platform alone. Just like changing his face, the dark face soon became happy.
"The trouble in Yongding River is indeed very difficult. We don't have any good solutions for a while."
"However, there is a Mohist genius who has an idea, and everyone is familiar with this young master!"
"His family background, talents, and his own research on Mohism are extremely impressive."
Pei Mao gave up, but everyone was confused. Who could make Pei Mao praise him to such an extent?
Dogwood?
However, this kind of person thought about it and realized that Pei Mao was talking about the young master just now. There is no doubt that he is a man.
So...
Everyone's eyes looked at the crowd, and finally they all fell on Meng Wenchuo.
There is no doubt about it.
Among the Mohist disciples present, aside from Cao Zhuyu, only Meng Wenchuo was the most popular.
And when it comes to family background, talent, talent, and research on Mohism, he is the only one who meets this condition.
Even Meng Wenchuo thought so.
He did have some ideas just now, but he didn't expect Pei Mao to actually invite him. Thinking of this, his face showed some pride.
Under Xie Rusu's admiring gaze, Meng Wenchuo straightened his clothes.
With a smile on his face, he walked towards the high platform facing everyone's gaze.
The crowd dispersed to both sides, as if welcoming a king, which made Meng Wenchuan extremely useful.
"This young master is..." Pei Mao drawled his voice, "The uncle of Shoutinghou Mansion, the solver of the cattle-sharing problem, Mr. Shen Wuming!"
